io_equilibrium.name: Equilibrium
io_equilibrium.description: Io gains outgoing damage amplification the closer it is to full health, and Health Restoration and Healing Amplification the closer it is to zero health.

io_tether.name: Tether
io_tether.description: Tethers Io to an allied unit, granting bonus movement speed to both. When Io restores health or mana, the tethered unit gains a portion of that amount. The tether breaks when the allied unit moves too far away, or Io cancels the tether. Tether slows enemies touching it.
io_tether.lore: The Eternal's benevolent touch fills others with interdimensional power.
io_tether.note0: If you attempt to tether to an ally 700 units or more away, you will be pulled to within 300 units of them.
io_tether.note1: A tethered ally regenerates health and mana faster, even if Io is at full health.
io_tether.note2: Io's movement speed is matched to that of the tethered ally.

io_spirits.name: Spirits
io_spirits.description: Summon five particle spirits that dance in a circle around Io. If a particle collides with an enemy hero, it explodes, damaging all enemy units in an area around it.  Creeps take minor damage from touching a particle spirit, but do not cause them to explode.  When its duration ends, any remaining Spirits explode.
io_spirits.lore: With unthinkable might, the Eternal spins the very particles of the universe.
io_spirits.note0: After summoning, Io can move the spirits closer or farther away.
io_spirits.in_custom_description: Pulls the spirits closer to Io. Recast to stop the movement.
io_spirits.out_custom_description: Pushes the spirits away from Io. Recast to stop the movement.

io_overcharge.name: Overcharge
io_overcharge.lore: By drawing cosmic energy from all realms, the Eternal begins to unravel time.
io_overcharge.description: Io gains attack speed, spell amplification, and health regeneration based on max health. If Io is Tethered to an ally, that unit also gains any bonuses granted by Overcharge.

io_relocate.name: Relocate
io_relocate.lore: Io is the embodiment of the universe's mysteries.
io_relocate.description: Teleports Io and a tethered ally to any location. After the spell expires, Io and the tethered ally will return to their original location. Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.
io_relocate.note0: Enemies see the teleport destination both in-game and on the minimap once the spell is cast.
io_relocate.note1: If stunned during the cast time, the teleport is canceled.
io_relocate.note2: If you are tethered to an ally, they will teleport with you. To prevent this, break the tether before teleporting.
io_relocate.note3: Only heroes, hero creeps, and illusions can be teleported.
